source_sha256_semantics: Hashes of unmodified docker/kin-kvm files at the pinned upstream commit, not checksums of this patched package.

kin-kvm-entry: Preserve existing overlay and identity; reject implicit destructive recreation.

Validate explicit claude/codex guest engine and propagate it in the seed environment.
Mount helper run and credential shares read-only in guest.
Optional operator service group can traverse run and connect relay socket without reading private configuration.
Restore root ownership before chmod on restart without granting CAP_FOWNER.
Configure allocated guest slirp subnet, gateway, address and reserved DNS explicitly, with loopback-only forwarding to the guest address; retain legacy defaults without a lease.
Generate static NoCloud network configuration without enabling guest DNS and include guest addressing in the per-boot seed environment.
kin-guest-exec: Preserve original SSH exit status instead of negated shell status.

Store root-owned service environment outside the disposable kernel RuntimeDirectory to preserve engine selection across restart and stop/start.

Apply allocated guest addressing by fixed MAC on each boot, including existing overlays, and verify actual address and default route before starting the kernel.
guest/kin-kernel-start: Keep Claude as the default; explicitly launch Codex with its configuration positional argument and remove inherited proxy environment variables.
guest/kin-kernel.service: Require the independent root-owned EnvironmentFile; missing configuration fails instead of silently selecting the default engine.
Disable automatic kernel restart; lifecycle generation owns recovery.
